info.name: CloudBin
info.description: Live checks for the CloudBin Compose stack. Run folders from top to bottom with the seed profile. For the final account workflows, use a local Mailpit inbox receiving OTP email or send the requests individually with manual OTPs. See docs/postman/README.md.

item.name: Health
item.description: Check the gateway, both backends, and each storage node directly.

item.name: Sessions
item.description: Sign in with the seeded accounts. This folder initializes a fresh object key and token name for every run.

item.name: Sign in as admin using login alias

item.description: Create a named token, use it to list tokens, then revoke it by the database ID returned by the list endpoint.

item.description: Reuse only the run-specific key. The admin acts on the demo user’s object.

item.name: Registration and password reset
item.description: Each workflow creates a disposable account. Mailpit lookup requests are for automated local testing. For manual checks, skip those two requests and set otpCode before each Verify request.

item.name: Canonical
item.description: Register, verify, sign in, reset the password and sign in again.

exec: const message = pm.response.json().messages.find(m => m.Subject === "CloudBin account verification" && m.To.some(person => person.Address === email));
pm.test("OTP message arrived for this account", () => pm.expect(message).to.have.property("ID"));
pm.test("Email contains a six-digit code", () => pm.expect(match).to.exist);
const message = pm.response.json().messages.find(m => m.Subject === "CloudBin forgot password" && m.To.some(person => person.Address === email));
pm.test("OTP message arrived for this account", () => pm.expect(message).to.have.property("ID"));
pm.test("Email contains a six-digit code", () => pm.expect(match).to.exist);
